mainEntity.name: Can AI plan social media content for a digital product launch without making misleading claims?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can support a launch calendar by mapping source content to awareness posts, educational explanations, objections, reminders, and post-launch follow-up. It should not invent product details, scarcity, testimonials, guarantees, or launch results.

Context: Run My AI Biz covers digital products, sales pages, funnels, email follow-up, and launch preparation. A coordinated workflow can reuse product research and educational material while keeping promotional claims tied to approved information.

Key factors:
- Confirm the offer, audience, date, and availability.
- Distinguish education from promotion.
- Match posts to funnel stages.
- Add approval before publishing or spending.

Practical guidance: Give AI the approved offer brief and ask for a launch sequence with source references and review status. Have a person verify every deadline, price, feature, link, and customer-facing claim.

AI can organize launch work, but the owner remains responsible for what the audience sees.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, if you provide an approved offer brief and require source-linked drafts. AI can organize awareness, education, objection handling, reminders, and follow-up, but a person must verify prices, dates, features, testimonials, guarantees, scarcity, and links.
